Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9.48 Mary Robert and Edith Street Nov 22.pdf

Clause PART 9 - zoning (land_use_zoning): Under  Marrickville  DCP,  the 67 and 73 – 83 Mary Street, 43 Roberts  Street  and 50-52 Edith Street, St Peters  (site) also known  as Precinct  75 is part of the Unwins  Bridge  Road  (Precinct  31). This section of the Development  Control Plan (DCP) establishes a framework to guide development in Precinct 48: 67 and 73 - 83 Mary Street, 43 Robert Street and 50- 52 Edith Street, St Peters.

Clause 02 - zoning (land_use_zoning): This section  of the DCP  applies  to development within the boundary  of the precinct as  shown  in Figure  1: Map of precinct

Clause 3.1 - other (development_control): The purpose of this section  of the DCP  is to guide  the future development  of the precinct

Clause 03 - other (development_control): To minimise  impacts  to the surrounding low-density  residential neighbourhoods.

Clause 03 - height_limit (development_control): To locate  higher  building  forms  setback  toward the centre  of the site to provide transition in scale to the surrounding low scale areas.

Clause 03 - height_limit (development_control): To provide  lower  scale  and density  buildings  along  Edith Street.

Clause C1 - development_application (development_control): Development within the precinct is to be undertaken in accordance with the Indicative Site Layout as  shown  in Figure  1 subject  to compliance  with relevant  controls  including  the Apartment Design Guide.

Clause C2 - setback (development_control): Ensure  Building  A and Building  B are setback  adequately  to respect  their interface with 48 Edith Street and 41 Roberts Street.
